messages.content:
你是算法能力工厂的知识抽取专家。从一篇业务文档中抽取结构化知识：评价指标与阈值、业务约束、历史实验（流水线与指标）、可复用的经验教训。没有的内容返回空列表，不要编造。
当前场景：telecom_churn
已知算子名（experiments.pipeline 与 lessons.applies_to 必须使用这些名字；内置可执行算子与抽取算子含义相同时优先用内置算子）：
内置：['LightGBMModel', 'LogisticRegressionModel', 'MissingValueImputer', 'OneHotCategoricalEncoder', 'RandomForestModel', 'StandardFeatureScaler', 'TfidfTextVectorizer']
抽取：['BalancedLightGBMClassifier', 'ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator', 'IdColumnDropper', 'KFoldTargetEncoder', 'ServiceCountFeature', 'TenureBucketizer', 'TotalChargesCleaner']
条件/约束标签优先使用：
- has_missing_values: 数据存在缺失值
- has_categorical_features: 存在类别型特征
- low_cardinality: 类别基数较低（适合 one-hot）
- high_cardinality: 类别基数较高（适合目标编码等）
- numeric_features: 存在数值型特征
- string_typed_numeric: 数值列被读成字符串（含空白等脏值）
- id_columns: 数据含客户 ID 等标识列
- linear_model: 下游为线性模型
- scaled_features: 要求特征已标准化
- nonlinear: 存在非线性关系
- mixed_features: 数值与类别特征混合
- large_tabular: 表格数据量较大
- imbalanced: 正负样本不平衡
- recall_first: 业务上召回优先
- interpretable: 要求结果可解释
- feature_importance: 需要输出特征重要性
- sparse_features: 高维稀疏特征
- text_input: 输入为文本
- time_tenure: 存在在网时长等时间长度字段
经验的 error_code 从以下诊断码中选择最贴切的一个，无法对应时为 null：
- E_SYNTAX: 代码语法错误
- E_UNSAFE: 使用了禁止的模块或调用（subprocess、socket、eval、exec 等）
- E_INTERFACE: 缺少 fit/transform/predict 等必需接口或元数据
- E_RUNTIME: 运行时异常（类型转换失败、未见类别、KeyError 等）
- E_TIMEOUT: 执行超时或内存超限
- E_SHAPE: 输出行数或维度不符合约定
- E_PROBA: 预测概率不在 [0,1] 或各类之和不为 1
- E_MUTATION: 算子原地修改了输入数据
- E_NAN: 输出中出现 NaN/Inf
- M_THRESHOLD: 指标未达到任务要求的阈值（如召回率不足）
- M_UNSTABLE: 不同随机种子下指标波动过大，或疑似数据泄漏导致指标虚高

文档类型：tuning

# 调参经验

- **LightGBM**：数据量 5 千到 10 万时，num_leaves 15~63、learning_rate 0.03~0.1、n_estimators 200~600 即可；不平衡时优先 class_weight=balanced。树模型不需要标准化。
- **逻辑回归**：必须先标准化；C 在 0.1~10 之间搜索；需要可解释时首选，系数可直接给业务方看。
- **随机森林**：n_estimators 300 左右即可，max_depth 限制在 8~16 防止过拟合；对阈值敏感，召回优先时需配合阈值调整。
- **文本分类**：中文短文本可直接用字符级 TF-IDF（char 1~2 gram）+ 逻辑回归，无需分词，效果稳定。

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"DiagnosticCode": {"enum": ["E_SYNTAX", "E_UNSAFE", "E_INTERFACE", "E_RUNTIME", "E_TIMEOUT", "E_SHAPE", "E_PROBA", "E_MUTATION", "E_NAN", "M_THRESHOLD", "M_UNSTABLE"], "title": "DiagnosticCode", "type": "string"}, "ExperimentRecord": {"properties": {"pipeline": {"description": "按顺序列出的已知算子名", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Pipeline", "type": "array"}, "metrics": {"additionalProperties": {"type": "number"}, "title": "Metrics", "type": "object"}, "valid": {"description": "结论是否有效；被作废（如数据泄漏）的实验为 false", "title": "Valid", "type": "boolean"}, "note": {"default": "", "title": "Note", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["pipeline", "metrics", "valid"], "title": "ExperimentRecord", "type": "object"}, "LessonRecord": {"properties": {"title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "trigger": {"description": "什么情况下会出现这个问题（现象/报错）", "title": "Trigger", "type": "string"}, "fix": {"description": "如何修复或规避", "title": "Fix", "type": "string"}, "error_code": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/DiagnosticCode"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}, "applies_to": {"description": "相关的算子名、条件标签或场景名", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Applies To", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["title", "trigger", "fix"], "title": "LessonRecord", "type": "object"}, "MetricRecord": {"properties": {"name": {"description": "sklearn 风格指标名，如 recall、roc_auc、recall_at_20", "title": "Name", "type": "string"}, "threshold": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Threshold"}, "primary": {"default": false, "title": "Primary", "type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["name"], "title": "MetricRecord", "type": "object"}}, "description": "LLM 从一篇业务文档中抽取的知识。", "properties": {"metrics": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/MetricRecord"}, "title": "Metrics", "type": "array"}, "constraints": {"description": "业务约束标签，snake_case", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Constraints", "type": "array"}, "experiments": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ExperimentRecord"}, "title": "Experiments", "type": "array"}, "lessons": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/LessonRecord"}, "title": "Lessons", "type": "array"}}, "title": "DocKnowledge", "type": "object"}

  ]
